To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the PR scheme can be used to improve the fairness of the DQDM (DQDB medium access control) protocol, but its performance is still far from ideal; (2) the MP scheme, which combines the advantages of PR and MD, is able to achieve good fairness, and its implementation is relatively simple; and (3) an analytical model for the entire DQDM protocol is presented, and its validity is verified through simulation.

(a) the MP scheme provides a better fairness than the PR scheme; (b) the MD scheme provides a better performance than the PR scheme, especially in a network that has a large number of stations and a large number of message types; (c) the MP scheme is the most fair scheme among those considered; and (d) the analytical model is verified by simulation.
